notes: 25 candidates: 4 program-list, 0 single-record, 21 not-a-list. Program lists: Kelley IU 2001-2008 sampling of academic placements across all areas (two Operations Management graduates: Elliot Bendoly 2001, Vikram Tiwari 2008); Iowa State Ivy College 2013-2017 placements for IS, Marketing and Supply Chain Management; Kent State College of Business PhD alumni 2005-2009 by department (no placements; mixes Management and Information Systems, Finance, Marketing, Accounting); LBS MSO recent PhD graduates 2015-2016 with placements. Institutions by host were kept for every page; the MIT Press ACM series page and the national Designfakulteten centre are not program pages of their host institutions. The MIT ESD symposium announcement names ESD PhD alumni with graduation years (PhD'00-'07) but gives no placements, so it was not treated as a list; an integrator could still use it as a lead for ESD names. Two pages display email addresses (Kent State, MIT ChemE CEP); do not copy those into proposals.
